description: This file defines the AppListAdapter class, which extends ArrayAdapter to manage and display a list of AppEntry objects in an Android application. The class handles inflating item views and populating them with app icon and label data.

classes.name: AppListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying a list of apps, inflating views, and binding app icon and label data.

methods.name: AppListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter and inflates layout inflater from context.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the list of AppEntry data to be displayed, clearing existing data.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides a view for each item in the list, inflating if necessary and populating icon and label.
